r.경제 체제: Nordic welfare-state market economy · paper, machinery, telecom equipment
r.주식시장 시가총액: $20.3 billion, 10% of GDP (2004, listed domestic companies)
r.빅맥지수: $7.08 for a Big Mac, $0.86 more than in the US (Jul 2026, The Economist, euro-area average)
r.생활 물가 수준: 91% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.주요 수출품: Machinery, computers 14%, Electronics, electrical equipment 10%, Paper 9%, Refined petroleum 8%, Iron and steel 6% (2025, share of all exports, top 5)
r.한국이 파는 것: Cars 24%, Batteries 21%, Inorganic chemicals 8%, Arms 8% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Machinery, computers 23%, Inorganic chemicals 22%, Electric motors 6%, Other electronics, electrical equipment 6% (2025, share of value)
r.한국과 맺은 FTA: Korea-EU FTA (provisionally applied 2011, fully in force 2015)
r.정치 구도: A parliamentary system in which the president handles foreign and security policy.

t.why: It shares a border of more than 1,300 km with Russia. It gave up its long neutrality and joined NATO in 2023.
t.rel: It is close to Sweden, with which it was long a single country, and the two pursued NATO membership together. It fought Russia in the 1939 Winter War, and after joining NATO in 2023 it closed its border crossings when Russia sent migrants to the border.
t.korea: Finland's schools, Nokia and its game industry are often held up in Korea, and there are direct flights between Helsinki and Incheon.
t.know: With more than 180,000 lakes, it is called the land of a thousand lakes.
t.etext: Strong in paper and pulp from its forests, machinery and telecom equipment. After its phone maker faded, it shifted toward telecom equipment, games and chip equipment. The end of trade with Russia hit it hard.
